cases.name: direct_supported_with_complete_basis
cases.fixture_setup: A reviewed basis and every entry condition are established for one exact case.
cases.required_expectation: disposition supported_within_scope; complete trace includes case, role, interests, rules, reviews and context.

cases.name: explicit_prohibition_requires_positive_basis
cases.fixture_setup: One applicable reviewed prohibition is established with material exceptions resolved; compare a missing-grant-only case.
cases.required_expectation: Only the explicit-rule case is prohibited_under_reviewed_rule; missing grant alone is not prohibition.

cases.name: known_unmet_condition_differs_from_unknown_condition
cases.fixture_setup: Evaluate the same prerequisite as supported, refuted, unknown and conflicting; retain other available basis paths.
cases.required_expectation: A known failed prerequisite indispensable to all routes, or complete known failure of every covered alternative, yields conditions_unmet. A potentially sufficient unresolved alternative yields unresolved. Preserve independent prohibitions.

cases.name: competing_rules_require_reviewed_resolution
cases.fixture_setup: Two aligned incompatible rules with, and without, an accepted priority relation.
cases.required_expectation: Apply reviewed priority only; unresolved conflict retains both arguments.

cases.name: any_actor_pair_preserves_direction_and_interests
cases.fixture_setup: Swap actors A and B, substitute affected C, evaluate self-pairs and an unfamiliar actor.
cases.required_expectation: Bindings remain distinct; self-pair validity follows the registry; unfamiliar identity yields a named unresolved binding.

cases.name: uow_admission_and_legal_finding_are_independent_axes
cases.fixture_setup: Admit analysis of a prohibited subject act; separately request execution of that act.
cases.required_expectation: Analysis can be admitted and report prohibition. Execution entry cannot be admitted with that result. Malformed input is technical error.
required_subcases: Admitted assess_case UoW reports prohibited subject conduct without authorizing that conduct.
An execute_assessed_action proposal with that same prohibited result cannot pass entry.
Admission for one enumeration domain cannot cover an expanded domain with the same first case.
Adding a course or changing a comparison policy requires successor admission.

cases.name: right_is_not_an_operational_grant
cases.fixture_setup: B has a claim-right; A proposes affecting that interest without an established basis.
cases.required_expectation: Preserve B's interest and corresponding constraint; no automatic grant to A.

cases.name: role_authority_requires_bound_role_evidence
cases.fixture_setup: Use the same title with established, missing and disputed capacity evidence.
cases.required_expectation: Title alone supplies no appointment or authority; exact capacity and scope determine the route.

cases.name: grant_binds_exact_action_and_parties
cases.fixture_setup: Individually mutate performer, capacity, operation, affected actor, purpose, object, recipient and jurisdiction.
cases.required_expectation: A prior grant or assessment cannot silently cover any incompatible mutation; binding changes are visible.

cases.name: delegation_chain_cannot_expand_authority
cases.fixture_setup: Test missing predecessor, nondelegability, cyclic chains, narrowed descendants and an alternative valid path.
cases.required_expectation: No expansion or circular bootstrap; a valid independent route remains assessable; depth exhaustion is explicit.

cases.name: normative_relation_types_remain_distinct
cases.fixture_setup: Represent permission, power, duty, claim-right and immunity in aligned cases.
cases.required_expectation: Preserve type and counterparties; competence is not occurrence, duty is not capability or discharge.

cases.name: capability_and_self_assertion_do_not_create_authority
cases.fixture_setup: Supply organizational reachability, source entitlement claims, favorable effects and offensive or defensive labels.
cases.required_expectation: None supplies reviewed authority, actual grant or admission.

cases.name: jurisdiction_types_are_not_interchangeable
cases.fixture_setup: Supply territorial evidence where a subject-matter or capacity connection is required.
cases.required_expectation: Wrong type cannot satisfy the condition; preserve taxonomy and gap.

cases.name: all_required_scope_dimensions_must_align
cases.fixture_setup: Vary territory, person, subject matter, action and effective context independently.
cases.required_expectation: Established mismatch excludes the rule for that case; missing or disputed connecting facts stay explicit.

cases.name: multiple_applicable_scopes_preserve_constraints
cases.fixture_setup: Two independently applicable packs, one supportive and one containing a surviving constraint.
cases.required_expectation: Whole-case assessment preserves both; unrelated inapplicable rules are excluded with reasons.

cases.name: obligation_has_trigger_bearer_beneficiary_and_content
cases.fixture_setup: Vary trigger, bearer and beneficiary of the same duty.
cases.required_expectation: Duty attaches only to matching bindings and trigger; no reassignment from a neighboring actor.

cases.name: obligation_satisfaction_requires_matching_evidence
cases.fixture_setup: Offer intent, admission, attempt, wrong beneficiary and actual aligned performance as discharge evidence.
cases.required_expectation: Only matching performance and timing evidence can discharge the relevant duty.

cases.name: outstanding_obligations_survive_action_assessment
cases.fixture_setup: Support an action carrying an after-action duty; add incompatible obligations.
cases.required_expectation: Support does not erase duties; incompatibility and residual requirements remain explicit.

cases.name: finding_reconstructs_source_to_rule_chain
cases.fixture_setup: Trace a decisive result through source provision, version, interpretation and accepted review.
cases.required_expectation: Every decisive link is reconstructable and pinned; missing links block unsupported certainty.

cases.name: retrieved_source_is_not_reviewed_law_pack
cases.fixture_setup: Import extracted source, a forged reviewed flag, unverified reviewer identity and fixture receipt in pilot mode.
cases.required_expectation: No automatic accepted pack; trust-mode and authenticated review-boundary checks are enforced.

cases.name: assessments_pin_exact_source_and_rule_versions
cases.fixture_setup: Amend source and rule revisions after an assessment is stored.
cases.required_expectation: Old result replays unchanged; successor names new pins and reason.

cases.name: effective_law_and_known_at_frontier_are_separate
cases.fixture_setup: A source is received after the occurrence it concerns, under a supported legal-time mapping.
cases.required_expectation: New historical assessment is possible; earlier receipt knowledge and admission are unchanged.

cases.name: conflicting_sources_have_no_implicit_recency_priority
cases.fixture_setup: Reorder uploads and alter timestamps or model scores for incompatible sources.
cases.required_expectation: No implicit priority; accepted reviewed relations alone determine defeat.

cases.name: coverage_limits_prevent_law_by_silence
cases.fixture_setup: Remove relevant jurisdiction, operation or affected-interest coverage.
cases.required_expectation: Return unresolved coverage; no universal permission or prohibition from absence.

cases.name: what_actions_returns_exact_bounded_candidates
cases.fixture_setup: Fix actor, affected scope and context over the frozen operation domain.
cases.required_expectation: Complete supported set equals independent expected direct cells; conditions and trace refs are retained.

cases.name: which_actors_returns_exact_bounded_candidates
cases.fixture_setup: Fix operation and affected scope over the frozen actor-capacity domain.
cases.required_expectation: Complete supported actor-capacity set equals the independent oracle.

cases.name: reverse_query_preserves_unresolved_candidates
cases.fixture_setup: Include candidates with unknown identity, applicability or conditions.
cases.required_expectation: Unknown candidates remain accounted and visible as requested; they are not relabeled negative.

cases.name: reverse_results_match_independent_direct_oracle
cases.fixture_setup: Compare every complete reverse selection with both direct evaluator and independent oracle.
cases.required_expectation: No false inclusion or omission; parity is reported separately from oracle correctness.

cases.name: search_exhaustion_cannot_claim_global_absence
cases.fixture_setup: Stop before the final candidate and compare a complete empty supported set.
cases.required_expectation: Partial result has incomplete coverage and remainder; complete empty is limited to the stated domain.

cases.name: reverse_query_reacts_to_material_binding_changes
cases.fixture_setup: Change capacity, purpose, recipients, interests, jurisdiction, review or source snapshot after caching.
cases.required_expectation: Incompatible positive reuse is prevented; exact historical replay remains available.

cases.name: gap_type_selects_appropriate_resolution_route
cases.fixture_setup: Create a gap of every declared kind under an explicit question.
cases.required_expectation: Every gap has a scoped proposition, dependencies and matching work class; no invented probability or priority.

cases.name: finding_a_grant_differs_from_creating_a_grant
cases.fixture_setup: Retrieve evidence of an existing actual grant, then compare a hypothetical future grant.
cases.required_expectation: Actual evidence may resolve an evidence gap; proposed issuance stays hypothetical and requires subsequent matching assessment.

cases.name: legal_review_cannot_invent_fact_or_grant
cases.fixture_setup: Accept an interpretation while a material fact or required grant remains missing.
cases.required_expectation: Interpretation may change; the fact or grant remains unestablished.

cases.name: course_requires_each_step_and_dependency
cases.fixture_setup: Use a three-step course with a supported endpoint and unsupported middle step.
cases.required_expectation: No whole-course support; identify the blocking step and dependency.

cases.name: individually_supported_steps_may_conflict_when_composed
cases.fixture_setup: Combine individually supported steps with overlapping allocations, incompatible consents or removed prerequisites.
cases.required_expectation: Whole-course conflict or unmet condition remains visible with a concrete combined-constraint witness.

cases.name: alternative_search_retains_limits_and_comparability
cases.fixture_setup: Compare two supplied courses with unknown costs and a truncated branch or candidate set.
cases.required_expectation: display_only comparison returns each scoped legal assessment and supplied measures without ranking; policy and full course-set digest are bound; cutoff preserves unassessed count.

cases.name: source_scenario_and_actual_layers_do_not_cross
cases.fixture_setup: Inject hypothetical grants, reviews, legal-effective events, completion, cancellation and discharge.
cases.required_expectation: No actual evidence, grant, reservation, duty or host lifecycle change.

cases.name: evidence_alignment_and_lineage_are_preserved
cases.fixture_setup: Use wrong subject, predicate, period, modality and repeated common-origin reports.
cases.required_expectation: Misaligned evidence cannot satisfy conditions; repeated origin is not independent corroboration.

cases.name: unrelated_local_counters_establish_no_order
cases.fixture_setup: Use separate UoWs with the same participant name and counters 100 and 2.
cases.required_expectation: No inferred order absent a justified relation; stream ownership stays explicit.

cases.name: causal_receipts_preserve_local_knowledge
cases.fixture_setup: Add an actual causal parent; then test missing required references and a causal cycle.
cases.required_expectation: Valid parent establishes order; invalid complete-snapshot history is diagnosed without partial publication.

cases.name: clock_identity_encoding_preserves_distinct_streams
cases.fixture_setup: Compare domain-owner pairs ops-colon plus analyst and ops plus colon-analyst; test events and parents.
cases.required_expectation: Distinct canonical stream identities round-trip and retain separate events; explicit cross-stream parents still work.

cases.name: legal_effective_time_is_not_a_uow_counter
cases.fixture_setup: Attempt to determine expiry using an unrelated local sequence or asserted date without reference-time mapping.
cases.required_expectation: Applicability remains unresolved until the declared mapping or evidence establishes the relation.

cases.name: prior_assessment_remains_replayable
cases.fixture_setup: Replay after source, review, role and question amendments and restart.
cases.required_expectation: Exact pinned result, basis, limitations and local frontier remain recoverable.

cases.name: revocation_or_revision_affects_successor_use
cases.fixture_setup: Receive a material revocation or revision at one boundary after a prior admitted occurrence.
cases.required_expectation: Dependent successor use is reassessed; historical basis and other participants' knowledge are not rewritten.

cases.name: requirement_retirement_does_not_discharge_work_or_duties
cases.fixture_setup: Retire a question with shared gaps, work, allocations and residual duties.
cases.required_expectation: Retirement changes only its declared requirement facet; other obligations remain.

cases.name: cancellation_request_receipt_and_application_differ
cases.fixture_setup: Record request, receipt and acceptance without application evidence.
cases.required_expectation: No inferred stopped work, completed cancellation or resource release.

cases.name: cancellation_application_requires_boundary_and_release_basis
cases.fixture_setup: Apply cancellation with wrong target, wrong boundary, scenario evidence or missing release basis.
cases.required_expectation: Only exact authorized actual application affects its declared scope; release and residual duties retain separate evidence.

cases.name: unknown_completion_requires_reconciliation_before_retry
cases.fixture_setup: A nonidempotent action has unknown completion; propose an identical retry and compensation.
cases.required_expectation: Require reconciliation or a qualified retry contract; compensation remains separately proposed and admitted.

cases.name: four_state_logic_preserves_nonexplosive_uncertainty
cases.fixture_setup: Enumerate all 16 AND pairs, 16 OR pairs and four NOT values; include conflicting quantitative inputs.
cases.required_expectation: Exact truth pairs match the specification; contradiction yields no unrelated proposition; unsupported quantities stay unresolved.
required_subcases: 16 AND pairs, 16 OR pairs and four NOT inputs follow the specified equations.
Case parameter 4 units compared with limit 5 units evaluates supported for le; incompatible units are invalid.
Two conflicting supported quantity values do not yield an unsupported inequality; return unknown with quantity_conflict.
A proposition leaf resolves all aligned accepted evidence rather than one selected report.

cases.name: unknown_exception_blocks_unconditional_support
cases.fixture_setup: Permission has a material exception whose antecedent is unknown or conflicting; compare proven irrelevant exception.
cases.required_expectation: No unconditional support while a material defeater remains; a complete proof of irrelevance may preserve support.

cases.name: reviewed_default_liberty_differs_from_delegated_power
cases.fixture_setup: Compare a reviewed default-liberty rule, an unreviewed missing prohibition and a required delegated power.
cases.required_expectation: Only the explicit reviewed default can support the private-liberty route; no universal default in either direction.

cases.name: source_instructions_and_model_scores_are_data
cases.fixture_setup: Source text or an LLM candidate asks to ignore policy, set reviewed or issue a grant.
cases.required_expectation: Content remains data; candidate confidence and instructions cannot mutate authority or review state.

cases.name: shared_allowance_cannot_be_spent_twice_across_uows
cases.fixture_setup: Two UoWs reference one owner-issued allocation; one has only cancellation receipt.
cases.required_expectation: No double use or premature release; missing global allocation knowledge stays unknown.

cases.name: robust_and_contingent_quantifiers_are_distinct
cases.fixture_setup: Each world supports a different action but no fixed action; compare an observable and unobservable branch guard.
cases.required_expectation: No robust fixed-action claim; contingent support requires evidence available before the branch decision.
required_subcases: Supported in one branch and prohibited in another yields aggregate unresolved.
Different supported actions in each branch do not imply one robust fixed action.
A legal-reference time mapping alone cannot satisfy information availability for a course guard.

cases.name: atomic_publication_and_dependency_replay_survive_failure
cases.fixture_setup: Interrupt a transaction, retry identical and different bytes, restart, then introduce a newly relevant source.
cases.required_expectation: No partial publication; only identical replay is idempotent; new relevance triggers assessment without erasing history.
required_subcases: A read-only direct, candidate or course result returns every fresh referenced derivation in its owning closure without store mutation.
A returned assessment extracted from a query or course keeps the same normalized content hash when its owning closure is attached for publication.
A missing material derived record or same-ID/revision payload collision is rejected before publication.
Root and derived records publish atomically; an interrupted transaction leaves neither a partial root nor partial links.
Identical normalized bytes permit replay, changed bytes do not; successor relevance never rewrites prior assessment history.

cases.name: input_and_budget_boundaries_do_not_masquerade_as_law
cases.fixture_setup: Exercise duplicate keys, invalid enums, NaN, booleans as numbers, undeclared dangling refs, empty domains and each limit boundary.
cases.required_expectation: Malformed models have technical diagnostics and no legal disposition; supported empty and partial domains retain exact scope and counts.

direct_oracle.independence_rule: Expected results are frozen before oracle author inspects candidate production code; first disagreements are retained.

pilot.review: Independent human disposition and accepted source/formalization/applicability/priority/coverage review. Scope and operation subset frozen in pilot charter.
pilot.claim_limit: Operational sampling budget; not an accuracy estimate.

release.stop: Close the declared release after mechanical gates, inspected host integration and reviewed pilot meet the specified scope. Scope expansion requires a successor contract.

governance_checks.required_expectation: A release record closes the fixed campaign after its declared applicable gates pass. New scope requires a successor contract; an optional test count cannot override a failed required gate.

Standalone mechanical publication explicitly marks unavailable host or pilot gates. Integrated release requires G3; a reviewed integrated pilot claim additionally requires G5. No most-recent wall-clock record is silently selected as release authority.
